The restaurant's other own-platform link (lahacienda.getbento.com/menus/) is a dead Clover Hospitality page with no content. allmenus.com carries a full, undated menu for the same restaurant that is systematically 10-25% LOWER than order.online on nearly every overlapping item (e.g. Al Pastor Taco $2.35 vs $2.75, Everything Burrito $12.70 vs $15.59, Surf and Turf Burrito $13.30 vs $15.10) with no single clean divisor across all items and one item (Chile Relleno Burrito, $10.75 both) matching exactly - a mixed signal rather than a clean markup ratio. Given allmenus is undated and this project has repeatedly found allmenus running stale by comparable margins (25-40% low) rather than order.online showing a uniform delivery fee, and no better first-party source exists, this is recorded at medium confidence per the trust ladder for a DoorDash white-label storefront rather than rejected outright - a wrong price here is a real risk worth flagging. Complete capture of every menu category on the order.online page: featured/classic/specialty/premium tacos, burritos, tortas, So Cal favorites, platillos, house favorites, vegetarian, dessert, sides/extras, kids, drinks and hot drinks. Complete capture of every section: appetizers, salad & soup, something fried, po-boy sandwiches, get your hands dirty (seafood boil by the pound), daily special, combo special, sides, fried rice/lo mein, kids menu, boba tea, beverages, smoothies, and dessert.
